title: Release v0.10.0 — cut the post-0.9.0 drive (TASK-074..094) as a versioned release
description: plugin.json has advertised 0.9.0 since commit 820671b, but the entire subsequent drive (console removal 074, unattended mode 075, deterministic-gate/state-resilience/crash-resume/injection-defense wave 081-086, agility trio 076-078, board-hardening 087, mcp/bundle/lock hardening 088-094) landed on top of it with no version bump. Because the marketplace source is "./", origin/main IS what Checking for updates for plugin "hivemind" at user scope… pulls — but the stale version string means updaters are not notified. Bump to 0.10.0 (minor, under 0.x: new features + the console removal), which the two-site pin enforced by tests/publish-config.spec.js requires be applied consistently. No CHANGELOG file exists in the repo, so none is updated. The orchestrator (not the developer) will create the annotated tag v0.10.0 and push main+tag after review — human already approved the bump and the tag/push.
acceptance_criteria: tests/publish-config.spec.js EXPECTED_VERSION set to 0.10.0 (the two-site pin — publish-config.spec.js fails if the sites disagree).
npm run test:all is green (release gate; includes publish-config parity + dist-parity so a stale dist/ or a one-site bump fails here).

No other files changed beyond the two version pins (and dist/ only if the gate demands a rebuild). Release commit authored by the developer; tagging + push are orchestrator release actions done post-review.
